meta.heading: Round 13: boxes, the toolbox, piles and drawers
meta.intro: Steps 3 and 4 are built: boxes and the toolbox, then piles and drawers.

r13-built3.title: Built: step 3, draw boxes, the toolbox, and folding boxes up
body: **The toolbox** sits down the left of the Desk; its arrow folds it away. It has three tools. **Move** drags empty paper to look around, as before. **Select** drags around cards to pick them, and dragging one then moves them all; **Box these** puts a box around them. **Box** drags to draw a box. **Shift + drag** draws a box whichever tool is on.

**What is this box?** After you draw one, pick a project and the cards inside get it, with one Undo for them all (a project that already has a box moves it here). Or make a **New project…**, or choose **Just a label**: a dashed box that only groups cards. Double-click a label's name to rename it, or right-click for Rename, Fold and Take off the Desk (with Undo).

**Folding.** Every box has **▴** on its name. It folds the box to its name and a count; **▾** opens it again. The count's colour shows how its cards stand: **grey** when nothing is waiting, **blue** when something is from today, **orange** when a ticket is still open or something is brought up. Folded cards and their link lines hide until you open the box.
**Moving a box moves everything in it**, folded or not. That was already the case and still is.

figures.caption: Select: two notes picked. Drag one and both move; Box these boxes them.
After drawing a box: what is it?
Two boxes folded: a label with 2 cards from today (blue) and a new project with 1.

r13-built4.title: Built: step 4, piles, drawers and Tidy into stacks
body: **Piles.** Drop a card on another card, or on a pile, and they pile up with a count on the corner. **Click** the pile to fan its cards out beside it, and click it again to put them back. **Drag a card away** to take it off; a pile left with one card comes apart. Drag the pile to move it, and double-click its count to give it a name. Right-click for Fan out, Rename, Take the pile apart, and File in.
**Tidy into stacks** (bottom bar) piles loose cards by project, one pile per project with two or more. Cards in a box or already in a pile stay put. Undo puts everything back.

**Drawers.** The cabinet sits under the toolbox, with one drawer per project plus folders you make (**+ Folder**). It stays folded until you pick something up, then slides out. Drop a card, a selection or a whole pile on a drawer to file it off the Desk. A project's drawer also gives the cards that project. Every filing has Undo.

**What's in a drawer.** Click a drawer to see its contents. Each one has **Open** and **Put back**, which lands it in the middle of what you're looking at. Folders can be renamed or removed; removing one puts its cards back on the Desk, and Undo files them again. Filed things still show in Find and count on the timesheet.

figures.caption: A pile of 3, fanned out to its right.
Dragging a jot: the drawers slide out and Reference lights up.
Filed, with Undo. The Reference drawer, opened.
